sloka: प्रतिबुद्ध्य ततो राजा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।राममानय सूतेति यदस्यभिहितो/अनया ॥२-१५-२६॥
transliteration: pratibuddhya tato rājā idaṁ vacanamabravīt ।rāmamānaya sūteti yadasyabhihito/anayā ॥2-15-26॥

translations.english: You had been asked by her (Kaikeyi) to bring Rama here. What is the reason the command is disregarded?
